title: Figure 5: Common solid-state lasers and their wavelengths
description: Horizontal wavelength scale labeled "Wavelength (microns)" from 0.4 to 2.0, with visible and near-infrared bands marked and arrows pointing to laser types including Nd:YAG X2, Rhodamine, Ruby, Alexandrite, Ti:Sapphire, Nd:YAG/Yb:YAG, Er:YAG, Tm and Ho. A note lists hosts such as Ruby, Sapphire, YAG, LuAG and Yttria with their chemical formulas. Caption reads "Figure 5. Common Solid-State Lasers and Their Wavelengths."
